key_insight: AI can help decode and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites by linking degradation mechanisms, prediction, and engineering strategies.
engineering_relevance: This framework supports more reliable perovskite solar cells and related devices by guiding stability screening, diagnosis, and materials/process optimization.
method: Stability discrimination and failure diagnosis from multimodal data
Microscopic mechanism analysis of coupled degradation pathways
Reliability prediction and engineering strategy design
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes that the field is limited by sparse statistics, protocol dependence, and uncertainty, motivating AI to integrate heterogeneous data and improve prediction quality.
watch_item: Model transferability and benchmark consistency remain a major concern because instability data are often noisy, protocol-dependent, and not standardized.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
